text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand what is going on with your baby, could you tell me about the mother's pregnancy and delivery, including any infections she may have had or risk factors present? I also need to know if there have been any changes in the baby's feeding or stool patterns since birth.

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of chorioamnionitis and low Apgar scores, I am highly concerned for neonatal sepsis or meningitis. I will immediately order a lumbar puncture and blood cultures to check for infection. REQUEST TEST: Lumbar_Puncture REQUEST TEST: Blood_Cultures
